agencies.name: Greater Bengaluru Authority Building Permission System

scenarios.label: Default building-plan public lead
scenarios.summary: A citizen reviews the current GBA/BPAS public entry and published building-permit guidance without signing in, submitting, paying or uploading.

sources.title: GBA Building Permission System public entry — current observation
sources.publisher: Greater Bengaluru Authority / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Unauthenticated page observation. The page displays Nambike Nakshe, single-window construction-permit text, five city-corporation choices (North, South, Central, East and West), a SIGN IN area with username/password/CAPTCHA, Citizen Search and Owner Search labels, project/owner-mobile fields, Quick Links for manuals/circulars and a support link. It also displays the notice that e-Khata is mandatory for Building Licence, Plinth Certificate and Occupancy Certificate applications from 1 July 2025. No credential, CAPTCHA, project number, mobile number or search was entered.

sources.title: GBA/BBMP Building Permission FAQs — current observation
sources.publisher: Greater Bengaluru Authority / Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike
sources.notes: Unauthenticated FAQ page observation. Building-permit answers publish online CAF/PreDCR and empanelled-professional guidance, document and NOC examples, risk categories, common rejection reasons, stages, timelines, fee guidance, status-search fields, architect/helpdesk recovery and completion/inspection guidance. No application or payment was made.

sources.title: GBA BPAS Helpdesk knowledge base — current observation
sources.publisher: Greater Bengaluru Authority / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Unauthenticated helpdesk page observation. Public knowledge-base browse/search is visible, with categories for payment issues, pre-sales questions and technical bug reports; the page also exposes a New ticket route and a sign-in control. No ticket or personal information was submitted.

sources.title: GBA BPAS Helpdesk New Ticket — current observation
sources.publisher: Greater Bengaluru Authority / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Unauthenticated New ticket page observation. The form displays Your email address, Subject, category/attachment controls and Project No. fields, plus the public knowledge-base/sign-in navigation. No fields were filled and no ticket was submitted.

claims.text: The current unauthenticated GBA BPAS entry displays five Bengaluru city-corporation choices, a username/password/CAPTCHA sign-in surface, Citizen Search and Owner Search labels, project/owner-mobile fields, and an e-Khata mandatory notice for Building Licence, Plinth Certificate and Occupancy Certificate applications from 1 July 2025.
claims.notes: Direct public-page observation on 2026-08-31. No sign-in, CAPTCHA, identifier or search was used.

claims.text: The current public FAQ says an applicant obtains building permission online with requisite documents and PreDCR drawings through an empanelled professional, and that the architect completes a Common Application Form containing plot and professional details.
claims.notes: The FAQ wording is recorded as published guidance; no professional was selected and no CAF was opened or completed.

claims.text: The current public FAQ lists plans/drawings, ownership documents, Khata extract or certificate and current tax receipt, plus digitally signed professional/safety declarations, and says NOCs depend on plot size, location, building type and height.
claims.notes: The page supplies examples and a dependency table, not a property-specific checklist. No document, drawing or NOC was uploaded.

claims.text: The current public FAQ names incomplete mandatory uploads, non-conforming plans, missing applicable NOCs or landowner/access-right documents, invalid ownership documents, Auto-Scrutiny drawing deviations and missing retained-structure evidence as common application-rejection reasons.
claims.notes: These are the FAQ's published common mistakes, not a rejection of a real case.

claims.text: The current public FAQ publishes building-permit stages including Concession, Concession order, IOD, First CC, Further CC, BCC and OCC, and says a citizen-search route can use file number, applicant, architect, zone, ward or plot/location fields to look up a file.
claims.notes: The search fields and stage labels were read from public FAQ text only; no identifier or live case lookup was performed.

claims.text: The current public FAQ says scrutiny fee is paid online with the application and other fees are charged through demand notes at construction stages, while another FAQ answer lists cash/cheque/DD at a CFC alongside online payment; the published fee-mode instructions are therefore internally conflicting.
claims.notes: The two statements appear in different FAQ sections on the same current page. No payment method was selected or used.

claims.text: The current public FAQ's building-permit Do's section instructs applicants to make all payments online through net banking or debit/credit card.
claims.notes: Retained with the separate FAQ payment-mode statement; this pass does not resolve which instruction applies to a current case.

claims.text: The current public FAQ publishes recovery routes for workflow problems: an architect may email the concerned Building License Department or IT helpdesk if the architect is not cooperating, and an architect with online-filing difficulty may use the helpdesk email/telephone/SMS/EODB support route; the public helpdesk also exposes knowledge-base browse/search and a New ticket form.
claims.notes: The FAQ's recovery wording is directed to an architect/LS. The public New ticket form visibly requests an email address and Project No.; no ticket or personal data was entered.

claims.text: The public-only pass does not establish the current property-specific corporation/route, required document or NOC set, scrutiny result, rejection text, inspection result, fee demand, payment acceptance, sanction decision or certificate output for any Bengaluru building-plan case; these are Unknown.
claims.notes: No login, property facts, professional selection, document/drawing upload, NOC request, live search, payment or submission was made.

claims.text: After the public GBA/BPAS entry's sign-in/CAPTCHA boundary, the current authenticated form sequence, validation messages, live submission handoff and case-specific recovery remain Unknown in this pass.
claims.notes: The sign-in controls were observed, but no credentials or CAPTCHA were used and no access-control bypass was attempted.

roadblocks.title: Authenticated case path not publicly verified
roadblocks.symptom: The current public entry shows sign-in/CAPTCHA controls, while the live authenticated form, validation and submission result were not observable.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Architect/owner account access and case-specific property/application state are required for the next workflow states.
roadblocks.recovery: Use the public FAQ and published architect/helpdesk routes; retain the authenticated form and case outcome as Unknown until an authorised user proceeds.

roadblocks.title: Document/NOC and scrutiny failure signals
roadblocks.symptom: The FAQ lists missing or non-conforming plans, ownership/access records, NOCs and Auto-Scrutiny deviations as common rejection reasons.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The proposal-specific document, drawing and NOC package does not meet the applicable requirements.
roadblocks.recovery: Use the published mistake list to correct the package with the authorised professional; no correction or resubmission was performed.

roadblocks.title: Published fee-mode instructions conflict
roadblocks.symptom: One current FAQ section says all payments are online, while another lists CFC cash/cheque/DD alongside online payment.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Different FAQ sections or legacy guidance have not been reconciled on the public page.
roadblocks.recovery: Obtain current authorised clarification through the published architect/helpdesk route before paying; no payment was attempted.

roadblocks.title: No case-specific approval outcome
roadblocks.symptom: No live project, status result, scrutiny remark, fee demand, payment, inspection, sanction, licence, CC, BCC or OC exists in this public-only pass.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Those states require an authorised route, case data and/or an actual municipal application.
roadblocks.recovery: Use a case-specific authorised search or filing and retain the project/reference number; do not treat FAQ stages as a live approval.
